data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve release of GBP 1.249 million for prior underwriting years (2011-2013), calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This release represents a substantial portion of the opening gross claims outstanding. The favorable development is consistent with the managing agent's report noting that loss ratios on all years of account remained below business forecasts, contributing to a profit on the closed 2013 year of account. The primary line of business affected is Accident & Health, as the syndicate primarily transacts term life assurance.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss ratios on all Years of Account remain below those allowed for in the Syndicate Business Forecasts.
data.data_quality_notes: The 'exact_reserve_text' for prior year development is null because the figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, not explicitly stated in narrative text. The prior year development percentage is very high due to a relatively small opening gross claims outstanding figure.
